page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 48 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing workloads. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory density position this instance for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading overhead. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it appropriate for relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
